_comment: CANDIDATE ONLY — NOT DEPLOYED, AND NOT REFERENCED BY firebase.json.
MAP Phase 6 (P6-C). Its own file for the same reason the Phase 6 Rules are:
the Phase 5 index candidate is part of a deployment package already handed
to the Owner, and a Phase 6 decision must not silently change what a Phase 5
deployment would apply. The Owner-facing package lists BOTH files, and a
check binds the package's hand-written index tables to these machine-readable
candidates so the two cannot drift.
Only ONE index is needed: listNotePlacementsForNote() is deliberately
equality-only (see its own comment), which is what keeps this to one.

indexes._query: note-foundation.js listNotePlacementsForFolder() — a folder's contents, in the author's own order
